[Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au)

Speedcubing Australia acknowledges the traditional owners of this land, the First Peoples of the Millewa-Mallee, being Latji Latji and Ngintait Traditional Owners, and pays respect to the elders, past and present for they hold the memories, the traditions, the culture and hopes of Aboriginal Australia.

items.name: Side Events Minnesota 2023
items.information:
This competition is a series competition with [NxN Minnesota 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NxNMinnesota2023). ***You may only compete in one of these competitions.*** [Please click here for more info about series competitions.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SideEventsMinnesota2023#32523-series-competitions-faq)

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association (MCA)](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcDAwIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9d340df17a1aec4ba42677c10d4db2f31757ffba/image.png)

We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Assocation](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing) for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.
